target_customer: Industrial, defense and logistics customers needing power delivered without cables
problem: Powering many sensors, robots and devices at distance requires cables or batteries.
business_model: Hardware and systems sales plus government contracts
product_category: Long range wireless power beaming (Reach Labs, Reach Power)

founders.name: Christopher Davlantes
founders.background_notes: VentureBeat says the company had roots at MIT and launched out of YC in 2015.

technical_complexity.rationale: Steerable RF beamforming for safe long range power transfer is a hardware and regulatory challenge.

defensibility.rationale: Deep RF engineering and safety certification are hard to replicate, but technology maturity was low.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer; company moved toward defense and drone customers.

market_need_then: Cable and battery limits for sensors and industrial devices; VentureBeat 2018 describes industrial targets such as health care, automotive manufacturing and package distribution.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline It's within Reach; claims of doing for power what Wi-Fi did for data

branding.brand_signature: Doing for power what Wi-Fi did for data

rebrands.why: Not stated; Reach Power Inc. filed REACH trademarks in 2022

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable word and clear tagline, but many companies share the name and no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Reach is developing long range wireless power, raised 9 million in 2018 and 30 million in 2022 from DCVC led rounds, and now targets defense, drones and logistics with DARPA and Air Force work. It is hardware heavy and long horizon, so it has not reached a commercial scale outcome in the sources found.
notes: Business Wire page returned 403; the Series B 30M led by DCVC comes from search result text from several outlets (The Register, eeNews). Dealroom lists an 11.3M Series A in 2018 and CB Insights 39M total across 6 rounds, unverified. The 2018 round is labeled Series A by DCVC's post title. No 2015 era competitor sources found (Energous, Ossia, WiTricity not confirmed in sources), so list empty.
